0.translation: Prepared annotations need only lengths and tables. DNA is used here to prepare the example annotation, not as a plotting requirement.

3.translation: Run independently in a fresh R session with optional dplyr. ⟦shared:0⟧ retains the first six recognition rows without changing intervals or strands. ⟦shared:1⟧ appends actual coordinates to source names for label-fitting demonstrations; the original table remains separate.

6.translation: In single circular mode, ⟦shared:0⟧ selects double. Single draws one backbone and double draws two. Keep the same sequence and 9 × 8 inch size, changing only style or double-line spacing. ⟦shared:1⟧ defaults to 0.025; band width ⟦shared:2⟧ defaults to 0.035. Neither is stroke ⟦shared:3⟧.

14.translation: Band represents the complete backbone with a filled polygon. seq_backbone_width controls its width, default 0.035. This is actual band geometry; only seq_style changes from the double baseline.

17.translation: From the band baseline, double only band width while retaining other settings.

20.translation: ## Circular direction, rotation, opening and fit ⟦shared:0⟧

21.translation: The zero origin is at 12 o’clock with clockwise coordinates. Positive rotation turns the complete plot counterclockwise. Relative to double above, each example changes only direction or gap. See the [rotation contrast](⟦shared:0⟧).

24.translation: | ⟦shared:0⟧ | 0 | Finite degrees; 90 places origin at 9 o’clock |

26.translation: | ⟦shared:0⟧ | 0 | Degrees in [0,360); does not remove bases |

27.translation: | ⟦shared:0⟧ | labels | labels/geometry/manual; controls inclusion of labels in fitting |

28.translation: | ⟦shared:0⟧ | 1 | Global aspect ratio, not a change in units |

29.translation: | ⟦shared:0⟧ | off | Coordinate clipping can cut exterior text |

30.translation: Automatic fitting may change overall scale and the readable subset of tick labels at fixed device size. Inspect text and leaders before fixing ⟦shared:0⟧; clipping is not loss of source data. Circular mode owns gap/direction and rejects geom_seq seq_gap/seq_orientation.

35.translation: ## Style centre name and length separately ⟦shared:0⟧

36.translation: Centre text is separate from labels along the backbone. ⟦shared:0⟧ and ⟦shared:1⟧ are separated by a newline by default; name also accepts a display string. Empty name_style/length_style lists accept fixed colour, size, family, fontface and lineheight. First hide only length. Then return to baseline and change only name_style size, retaining the length text style.

47.translation: ⟦shared:0⟧ replaces the double backbone with one line. The centre label and bp ticks remain visible.

51.translation: The default ⟦shared:0⟧ places the sequence origin at 12 o’clock, with coordinates increasing clockwise. Here ⟦shared:1⟧ moves it to 9 o’clock, rotating the ticks and replication origin together. The annotation still covers the same source bp interval. Next, [prepare your own sequence and annotations](⟦shared:2⟧).
